mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the cost of capital for corporations and encourages risk-taking, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day SPX return when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 10.0%) signals weak labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 10.0%, or Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and unemployment is high (UNRATE > 10.0%), the combined signal of accommodative policy and recessionary conditions leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate policy support.
failure_condition: Average 20-day SPX return when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 10.0% is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05), or Rank IC for the interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession (UNRATE > 10.0%), strong housing market activity (HOUST > 950.0) signals consumer resilience and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In recession periods (UNRATE > 10.0%), average 20-day SPX return when HOUST > 950.0 is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05), or Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day SPX returns in recession periods is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 60-day SPX return when CPIAUCSL is in the top 25% of historical range is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity and corporate capacity utilization, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to immediate economic momentum.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 5-day SPX return when INDPRO is above its 50th percentile is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Above-average retail sales (RSAFS > 480000.0) indicate strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 480000.0, or Rank IC between RSAFS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP (GDPC1 > 18500.0) signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are supported by strong aggregate demand.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 18500.0, or Rank IC between GDPC1 and 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
